summary: @ornikar/repo-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` under that alternate runtime. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily-obfuscated bundle (rotating string array via a `WV8StW` shift-decoder, custom 64-character alphabet decoder, hex identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose behavior cannot be inspected from Node-based tooling. The payload's contents are unrelated to the package's stated purpose (Ornikar shared commitlint/prettier/husky configs). The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling file — evades Node-based scanners and executes attacker-authored bytes on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
